data.name: Harun
data.gender_notes: Harun is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Aharon (Aaron); the etymology is uncertain, often given as 'mountain of strength' or 'exalted'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-h-r-n. The prophet Hārūn (Aaron), brother of Mūsā. Harun is a Arabic name meaning “Mountain of strength; exalted”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Harun expresses “Mountain of strength; exalted”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Aharon (Aaron); the etymology is uncertain, often given as 'mountain of strength' or 'exalted'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harun total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
